title: Tax register of Leiden, 1674
authors: European Social Fund/DABURH, Department of History, Leiden University
contributors: European Social Fund/DABURH, Department of History, Leiden University (research initiator)
descriptions: The dataset is based on two sources, both originating from the year 1674: 1) a capital assessment list: 'Tweehonderdste Penning' and 2) an income assessment list: 'Klein Familiegeld'. For the capital tax there are 2 files: one for individuals and one for assessments. The income tax has only 1 file. Some individuals appear in both sources. Website: http://www.janvanhout.nl/leilas/gjp_frame.htm
